newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Security Capital raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Security Capital raised.

text.p: -- Chicago Corp said Tuesday it raised Security Capital Corp to a buy from hold, and also raised its 1997 earnings estimate by $0.54 a share to $4.44.
-- It set a 1998 earnings estimate at $4.75.

-- "We like (Security Capital) because of its potential for stronger-than-consensus earnings..., our belief that (Security Capital's) actual performance is much stronger than reported results indicate, and the enhanced attractiveness of (Security Capital) as an acquisition target...," Chicago Corp said.
-- It added there is little downside risk to the shares given the company's solid fundamentals, attractive franchise and continuing share repurchase program.
-- Security Capital shares were up 1/2 at 61.
